articles.title: Patriots Stock Watch 1.0: Who is rising, falling on depth chart after 11 days of practice?
articles.description:
Both A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez have lived up to their billing as elite talents so far during camp.

summary: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez excelled during 11 days of Patriots training camp.

articles.title: Police search for person they say broke into Jamaica Plain apartment, tried to pull blanket off sleeping victim
articles.description:
The victim told police the suspect climbed in his window while he was sleeping, police said.

The post Police search for person they say broke into Jamaica Plain apartment, tried to pull blanket off sleeping victim appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Police are searching for a suspect in a Jamaica Plain apartment break-in.

Residents are urged to secure windows and report suspicious activity.
